why: The Teacher Noticing of Rationality Framework is an education-specific analytic framework for operationalising and studying how teachers attend to, interpret, and shape evidence of students' mathematical thinking, not a general theory of learning.
name: Teacher Noticing of Rationality Framework (TNRF)

why: T-NOTECHS is a named assessment instrument that users adopt for video-based evaluation of emergency resuscitation teams' non-technical skills.
name: T-NOTECHS
product_description: T-NOTECHS is a five-domain, anchored Likert-scale assessment tool for rating leadership, communication, situational awareness, decision making and teamwork during recorded resuscitations.

why: T-NOTECHS is a named behavioral observation assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: T-NOTECHS
product_description: T-NOTECHS is a five-domain behavioral observation instrument for rating trauma-team non-technical skills during resuscitation, adapted from aviation NOTECHS.
